notes.title: Divine Gems Fraud Update
notes.content: [p]Hello all. We have some upcoming changes to purchasing Divine Gems that will help make our game a safer place. Fraud in the Marketplace has caused ongoing issues that hurt the in-game economy and disrupt balance. To prevent further abuse and protect the integrity of the ecosystem, we’re updating our previous fraud measures.[/p][p][b]All Divine Gems packages purchased on Steam will now be pending for a 72-hour period before they can be used in the Marketplace.[/b] [/p][p]Please see a detailed breakdown below:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Diving Gems Purchasing Update Details[/b][/h3][p]All Divine Gems packages will have 100% of the Gems within the packages flagged as (Pending). (Pending) Gems cannot be used on the Marketplace for 72-hours. Players can still utilize (Pending) Gems on the Divine Gem Shop (inside the Hongmoon Store) and purchase the Battle Pass without any limitations. After 72-hours (Pending) Gems will automatically be converted to their standard Divine Gem balance.[/p][p]To confirm or view how many Divine Gems are (Pending) simply mouseover your Divine Gem balance in-game, and it will show you how many Diving Gems are (Pending).[/p][p][/p][p][b]TL;DR[/b][/p][list][*][p]100% of Gems purchased on Steam will be on a 72-hour hold for use [i]only[/i] in the Marketplace[/p][/*][*][p]Purchases in the Hongmoon Store / Divine Gem Shop and for Battle Pass will not be affected.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your understanding as we work to combat harmful activity. Please keep these changes and new processing time in mind when making a new Divine Gems purchase. We will continue to monitor these changes and will always strive to make any improvements to this system in the future.[/p][p] [/p]

We would now like to inform you of the results of the investigation and what we did to help repair the Marketplace.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What Happened?[/b][/p][p]Before the Steam launch, our team put forth several protective measures to combat potential fraud. One of these measures was adding the (pending) gems in our Divine Gems Fraud Update before launch, that could limit the number of Divine Gems purchased and that were immediately useable. Unfortunately, this plan did not fully work in combatting fraud and malicious accounts were able to exploit this heavily in a short period of time. As a result, our Marketplace suffered greatly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How Did We Fix This?[/b][/p][list][*][p]All accounts that committed direct fraud were immediately banned and their account items and gems were confiscated.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]After this, we brought down the Marketplace for a week to investigate the damage done by the accounts who committed fraud and flooded the market with fraudulent Divine Gems.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]During the investigation, we first fixed the way in which malicious accounts originally exploited the system.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Next, we discovered that several players actively engaged in RMT by purchasing the fraudulent gems from illegal third-party sites.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]For accounts that actively participated in this RMT, we have sanctioned their accounts for 7-days and removed the fraudulent Divine Gems from their accounts. After we removed the Divine Gems, their accounts were restored. notes.title: Marketplace Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello Crickets,[/p][p]
Once again, thank you for your continued patience as we deal with our current Marketplace issue. We appreciate your support and the information you provided during this time. Please see below for an update on this occurrence from our team.
[/p][p][b]Summary[/b][/p][p]
Before the Steam launch, our team put forth several protective measures to combat potential fraud. One of these measures was adding the (pending) gems in our Divine Gems Fraud Update before launch, that could limit the number of Divine Gems purchased and that were immediately useable. Unfortunately, this plan did not fully work in combatting fraud and malicious accounts were able to exploit this heavily in a short period of time. As a result, our Marketplace suffered greatly.[/p][p]
[b]How We’re Fixing This[/b][/p][p]All accounts that committed direct fraud have already been banned and their account items have been confiscated.[b]
[/b]
Our next goal is to remove fraudulent excess gems from the economy. To do this, we will temporarily bring down the NA and EU Marketplace for 1 week to investigate all transactions associated with those malicious accounts. The World Boss auction will also not be available during this week. During this time, we will remove all gems and items deemed to be directly related to fraudulent accounts. We will provide you with more information after the investigation is completed.

[b]What Will Happen with My Current Marketplace Items?
[/b]
All items that were on the Marketplace before the latest maintenance will be removed and returned to the seller.

[b]What We’re Doing for Affected Players
[/b]
During this investigation, the Marketplace will not be available for 1 week. We apologize for this inconvenience, but it will be necessary to preserve and repair the integrity of the market.  In the meantime, we would like to offer compensation to all players:
[/p][list][*][p]    During the week-long investigation, we will provide an Attendance Event that will compensate players and aid in progression without a Marketplace.  [/p][/*][*][p]    The Attendance Event will have 7 days of rewards, but we will allow you to complete it in 14 days for those who are not able to log in daily.  [/p][/*][*][p]    Additionally, we will also close the current Attendance Event and automatically give the full 21 days of rewards to all players who have already logged in during this month’s attendance book.  [/p][/*][*][p]    Please stay tuned for a full breakdown of these rewards.  [/p][/*][/list][p]In summary, by closing the Marketplace for a short time and working on the issues, we can then re-open and bring back the gameplay experience you were hoping for. Thank you again for supporting us during this unfortunate time. We hope the above activities will help provide a rewarding experience that will help you progress while our Marketplace is repaired.[/p]

It's here Crickets! B&S NEO is now on Steam! Blade & Soul NEO was originally launched on February 25, 2025 on its own proprietary platform ‘PURPLE’ and will now become more accessible to players on the world’s biggest PC distribution platform, Steam, for the first time. We look forward to seeing all of the adventures and memories to come.

[h3][b]Number of Character Slots[/b][/h3]
All players will have 3 character slots total. It cannot be expanded further for now.

Buckle up! As a thank you gift for the overwhelming response to our Steam launch, we’d like to offer our a choice between a PURPLE or Steam inspired outfit! Choose which fits you best! 1 per account! Sport your favorite launcher color or pick what suits you the most. Stay tuned for more details and a preview of the costumes in the next few days.

[h3][b]Cross-play With PURPLE[/b][/h3]
Steam and PURPLE will now support cross-play compatibility and all servers will soon be fully accessible on both platforms, meaning players on Steam and PURPLE will be able to play together.

[h3][b]Steam Launch FAQ[/b][/h3]
[b]
Are all servers accessible on both Steam and PURPLE? Can all players play together?[/b]

Yes, all servers will now be accessible via Steam and/or PURPLE. This means cross-play is now possible. All servers are accessible via Steam and/or PURPLE.

[b]Are there separate servers for both Steam and PURPLE?[/b]

No, all servers are now accessible for both Steam and PURPLE. However, there are new servers opening for those that want new server / fresh start experience.

[b]Are there separate NA and EU servers?[/b]

Yes. We offer separate servers for NA and EU.

[b]Are there any New Servers for a fresh start experience?[/b]

Yes. There is currently one new server for both NA and EU. You can choose to join the new servers or jump into the old servers to join your friends who are already playing NEO.

[b]Are there any incentives for new players?[/b]

Yes! We will be hosting a New Player Catch Up Event during the Steam launch. This event will be accessible across all servers for new and returning users. A returning user will be classified as a player that has been dormant for 30-Days.

[b]What countries are currently supported by Steam and PURPLE?[/b]

We will continue to support the same countries in Steam as we do in PURPLE.

[u]Play on North America Servers: [/u]USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile, Ecuador, Australia, New Zealand

[u]Play on Europe Servers: [/u]Czech Republic, Belgium, France, UK, Germany, Ireland, Sweden, Netherlands, Switzerland, Italy, Greece, Denmark, Finland, Lithuania, Portugal, Spain, Austria, Romania, Turkey

[b]Are we still supporting PURPLE?[/b]

Absolutely. PURPLE will still be supported for all of our games. The platform will continue to be updated and development is still ongoing.

[b]Are all marketplaces linked across all servers?[/b]

Currently, all Existing Servers will share a Marketplace that is linked to their NA or EU region. Each New Server will have their own unique Marketplace and Instance Server to promote a fresh start on the New Server. This means that the New Servers will not share Dungeons and Battleground with the other servers.

We chose to give New Servers their own unique Marketplace and Instance Server to promote a fresh start experience.

notes.content:
[b]UPDATED on May 23, 2025:[/b] Cross-play is now coming!

Hello Crickets!

We are thrilled to share that Blade & Soul NEO will be coming soon to Steam!

We also have a very exciting update to share: [b]Steam and PURPLE will now support cross-play compatibility and all servers will soon be fully accessible on both platforms,[/b] meaning players on Steam and PURPLE will be able to play together.

Players have made it clear that this should be a priority, and as a result, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes to make this happen.

When we first announced our Steam launch, there were several technical and logistical challenges preventing us from having the servers be cross-platform, ranging from account permissions to backend data integration. This made cross-platform difficult at the time, and we decided to move forward with separate servers, while keeping cross-play a goal in the future. We also saw value in the “fresh start” experience Steam users would get.

However, your feedback is clear:[b] separate communities are not the future NEO players want for the game.[/b] A united player base brings energy, competition, and longevity to the game and all servers. While we originally saw this separation as temporary, the overwhelming feedback has helped accelerate our plans to make this work [u]now.[/u]

Our initial goal was to launch Steam with this latest update, Moonwater Plains Part 3, but we have now shifted our focus to enabling cross-play as our top priority. We’re working hard to make this a reality for our upcoming Steam launch. To all of you who voiced your thoughts and opinions in Discord: thank you. Your input has been very valuable and we are grateful for your continued support and understanding as we work to make this goal possible. You can see our updated FAQ in the article below. All details are still subject to change as we are working on the launch.

Thank you,
NC America & the Blade & Soul Team

notes.title: 2025 Loading Screen Art Contest Winners
notes.content:
[h3]Presenting the Grand Prize Winners![/h3] 

Hello Crickets! The time has come to reveal the winners for the first Blade & Soul NEO Loading Screen Art Contest! It was a joy to see the large amount of submissions received and this continues to prove that our creative and artistic community in Blade & Soul continues to thrive. Thank you to all the wonderful and talented artists who spent time and effort on submitting their work on [url=https://discord.com/invite/QQgpDm6vPj]Discord.[/url]

Additionally, we are excited to let you all know that the Blade & Soul NEO development team made a special visit to our office, and even helped judge the Loading Screen Art Contest and Costume Design Contest. They too were very impressed with our community.

The number of entries we received was so impressive that we have decided to increase the number of Grand Prize winners from (5) to (7). The seven winning entries have been embedded below!

7 Grand Prize Winners will receive the following:
[list][*]Each will have their art placed into the game’s loading screen rotation for at least a 3-month period[/*][*]A special “Local Artist” Discord Role[/*][*]Gunner’s Oath costume[/*][/list]
